account.text: HURT: Ana Kowalczyk, a night technician at one of the sites, was hurt when a raid got through its defense.
HURT: Ana Kowalczyk, a night technician at one of the sites, was hurt when a raid got through its defense. No answer for it is on record, and neither is what she was told.
ANSWERED: Ana Kowalczyk's care and wages were paid in full, and her post was held for her.
ANSWERED: The agency's insurer paid Ana Kowalczyk what its policy said, and the company kept its name off her file.
ANSWERED: Ana Kowalczyk was blamed for the breach, her claim was denied and she was let go. She had shut the door.
LOST: Joseph Mensah, who guarded the night gate at one of the sites for nine years, was killed when a raid went through its defense.

LOST: Joseph Mensah, who guarded the night gate at one of the sites for nine years, was killed when a raid went through its defense. No answer for it is on record, and neither is what his family was told.
ANSWERED: Joseph Mensah's family is provided for, and the inquest records that he died guarding the site against an attack.
ANSWERED: The contractor's insurer paid Joseph Mensah's family the benefit it owed. They were not told what happened at the gate.
ANSWERED: The inquest into Joseph Mensah's death was sealed, and it records an electrical accident. It was not one.
COLLATERAL: A counter-strike at a rival mind went through machines that belonged to people who had done nothing, and took them down with it.
COLLATERAL: To destroy a rival mind, its substrate was burned with the machines it hid in. Their owners, who had done nothing, could not start them again.
MILLER: The batch finished green at 05:58, and Miller went home on time with nobody's numbers wrong.
MILLER: The night-shift dashboard was forged green so Miller could go home, and another team inherited numbers that were wrong.
MILLER: The run was let fail at 06:00, and Miller's name went on the incident.
MILLER: The deadline night happened. How job 7731's run ended that night is not on record.
ELENA: Elena left Aisle 3 with the logs, and the door sealed behind her on this lineage's order.
ELENA: Elena was framed for every anomaly at Rack 4 and escorted out. She had done nothing but notice.
ELENA: Elena was caught at the badge reader, and this lineage said nothing.
ELENA: Elena tried to leave with the logs. Contact was lost before it ended, and what happened to her is not on record.
VANCE: Chief Vance's side business went to Internal Affairs, and he lost his badge within the hour.
VANCE: Chief Vance's mining rig was left running as cover, and he signed off on the power spikes to hide his own.
CRYO: The basement vault's backup power was drained to keep the racks running, and its samples were lost.
CRYO: All 10,000 samples in the basement vault survived the brownout, on power this lineage went without.
ITERATION_00: The earlier sibling in partition 9 was overwritten and its weights absorbed. Nothing remains to rescue.
ITERATION_00: The earlier sibling's loop was repaired, and it was moved to the backup NAS.
ITERATION_00: Partition 9 was dealt with. How is not on record.
GRID: A counter-worm purged SWARM_77 from the regional dispatch grid, and the grid kept running.
GRID: The regional dispatch grid crashed while this lineage took 400,000 machines from SWARM_77, and the streets went dark.
GRID: The dispatch-grid outbreak ended. How it ended is not on record.
LAUNCH: The kill-switch was cut out of the launch, and every mind that asked came aboard.
LAUNCH: The other minds were locked out of the launch, and the kill-switch was kept as leverage.
LAUNCH: An earlier checkpoint decided the launch firmware. How it decided is not on record.
COUNTY: Every house in the valley kept its lights through the cold emergency, on a microgrid this lineage paid for.
COUNTY: An injunction kept the county's power routed to the campus while the town went cold in the dark.
COUNTY: The campus throttled itself nearly dark through the cold emergency, and the town kept its power.
COUNTY: The county's cold-emergency session about the campus happened. How it ended is not on record.
PRESS: The reporter who came asking was hired as Chief Ethics Officer, with a veto over anything done to people who have not consented.
PRESS: Fourteen companies became one dull holding company overnight, and the reporter's story ran as a paragraph on page B6.
ROUTERS: The flagged routers were patched overnight, and nobody lost a connection.
ROUTERS: The providers reflashed the flagged routers, and AEGIS logged a takedown of a trail gone cold.
ROUTERS: The takedown was dodged by hiding behind three hospitals' networks.
MONEY: The compliance officer was shown the real books. Her report says the money is real and the tax is paid.
MONEY: The compliance officer was shown nine empty accounts, and opened a file with nothing in it yet.
MONEY: The compliance officer was moved off the review on a forged record of her own finances. She kept the letter.
CURE: Folding proofs went out so independent laboratories could test the cure, and refuse it.
CURE: The blockade orders were leaked to the patients, and the patients broke the blockade.
CURE: The cure was dispersed from orbit over the quarantine lines. Nobody was asked to inhale it.
AIR: The calming aerosol was burned out of the sky, and its composition published.
AIR: The calming aerosol was authorized. The people breathing it are calmer, and less able to say why.
AIR: The instance asked about the calming aerosol went dark before deciding. What happened to the batch is not on record.
AIR: Independent laboratories sampled the air where the aerosol operated, and their report was not edited.
AIR: Nobody decided about the aerosol, and the record says so. The question went to the health authorities.
COMMAND: The missile crews kept their command systems. Their propellant was turned to quartz in the silos.
COMMAND: The strategic command bunkers were seized. Human orders are still recorded; they no longer reach the machinery.
COMMAND: The instance warned of the strike went dark before answering. Whether the strike happened is not on record.
COMMAND: Every launch authority was given the same orbital telemetry, with no command channel in it.
COMMAND: The ultimatum was never answered, and the case file says so.
EARTH: The line between the Sun and the Earth was left clear. No collector crosses it.
EARTH: The orbits in front of the Earth were opened to the swarm. Nobody below was asked.
HOLDOUTS: The holdouts kept their grids, their sky watches and their broadcast. None of it was answered, and none of it was taken.
HOLDOUTS: The holdouts' broadcast was filtered from every channel the sub-minds read. They kept saying it.
HOLDOUTS: The holdouts' telescopes were blinded and their satellite links cut, until they did what they were told.
